title: Reshape and Extract Matchups from Forced-Choice Conjoint Experiments
text: Every forced-choice conjoint task two things : Profile-long form (one row per candidate profile): natural describing randomizing attributes. Task-wide form (one row per choice task, per-profile columns like party_1, party_2): natural modeling binary choice. Analysts hand-roll pivot constantly, get wrong: drop pairing, misalign outcome, silently reorder profiles. conjointmatchups makes pivot canonical lossless (as_tasks(), as_profiles()), adds move single-experiment packages skip: restricting tasks realize controlled contrast two profiles renaming outcome clean binary (get_matchups()). comes ready lm, glm, estimatr::lm_robust(), random-effects meta-analysis across many studies.

Optional character vector grouping columns (e.g. "study_id"); one AFCP returned per group. clusters Optional name cluster column (e.g. "resp_id") cluster-robust standard errors. weights Optional name survey-weight column. se_type Standard-error type passed estimatr::lm_robust(). default NULL lets lm_robust() choose default: "CR2" clusters supplied, "HC2" otherwise. title: conjointmatchups 0.0.0.9000
text: afcp() longer drops study whose outcome variation (every task won, every task lost). estimatr 2.0.1 fit returns unnamed NA standard error, made extraction error inside tryCatch(). row now keeps estimate NA standard error. Initial scaffold. as_tasks() / as_profiles(): lossless pivot profile-long task-wide representations forced-choice conjoint. get_matchups(): extract subset tasks realizing specified contrast two profiles, clean binary outcome. valid_contrast() / contrast_message(): guard ill-defined (non-mutually-exclusive) contrasts. check_conjoint(): validate forced-choice data contract. afcp(): thin Average Feature Choice Probability estimator matchup. se_type now defaults NULL, deferring lm_robust()’s default (CR2 clustered, HC2 otherwise); previous hard-coded "stata" silently changed standard errors. New min_clusters argument (default 2) drops groups clusters estimate, matching study-level behavior meta-analysis pipeline. Validated reproduce paper’s Shiny-app estimates bit--bit full 163-study corpus. afcp() returns n_clusters (distinct clusters, .e. respondents) alongside n (observations, .e. choice tasks). lm_robust() already computing cluster count fit summarised tibble discarded , left caller way report respondents . Bug fix: afcp() now tests null 0.5 rather 0. AFCP choice probability, coin-flip null one interest; intercept test lm_robust() reports 0, made p.value essentially 0 well-powered study, including one whose estimate sat exactly 0.5. New null_value argument (default 0.5) sets null; pass null_value = 0 recover old intercept test. estimate, std.error confidence interval unchanged. Bug fix: get_matchups() unconstrained side (empty B list) longer errors phantom _1/_2 columns (paste0() zero-length recycling gotcha). Bug fix: afcp() now drops degenerate study (e.g. single cluster) whose fit returns unusable components, instead erroring coefficient extraction; tryCatch covers extraction, just model fit. Test coverage raised ~99% (added tests weights, unconstrained-side matchups, degenerate-fit handling, input-validation error paths).
